goal: Use authentic evidence photographs when showing an observed object or experiment; use clearly labeled explanatory 2D/3D scientific diagrams when explaining mechanisms; animation only when motion is essential and platform support has been verified.

documentary_photo.source: Wikimedia Commons or vetted primary institution

explanatory_2d.visual_style: clear restrained science explainer, precise labels when scientifically validated

visual_rules: Do not present synthetic illustrations as documentary photographs
Never modify authentic photographs to change scientific evidence
Match every visual to a specific claim and article section
Caption/source attribution in export metadata and policy-compliant rendered placement
Reject assets with unverified claims or image rights
